dataset_title: Ferti-Dig French agricultural digestate published summary statistics
license: CC BY 4.0 for the source article and transcribed aggregate Table 1 statistics. The underlying data.gouv dataset has separate custom terms: non-commercial use, notification on download, and required citation; no raw dataset files were downloaded or redistributed.
source_location: Caradec et al. (2025), Table 1, French digestates collection summary (n=608)
geography: 165 French agricultural anaerobic-digestion plants; the article reports digestates sampled/compiled across 2006-2022.
data_handling: Transcribed only published aggregate median, first/third quartile where available, and missingness values from Table 1. collection_size_n=608 denotes the French collection size, not the valid observation count for every parameter; parameter-specific valid counts are not reconstructed from rounded missingness percentages. No raw participant/site rows were accessed, imputed, or redistributed; no conversion, reweighting, or synthetic grass-only subset was created.
dataset_context: The companion repository describes 608 French agricultural digestates and 198 literature observations. Feedstocks and operating conditions are heterogeneous; livestock effluents are common. This summary file covers the French collection only.
limitations: Not roadside grass or GreenHub post-protein digestion evidence; no grass-only cohort can be isolated from the aggregate table.
Aggregate concentration statistics do not supply digestate flow, mass balance, nutrient capture, reagent demand, or fertilizer compliance data.
The data.gouv repository dataset has custom non-commercial terms and a download notification/citation requirement; raw files are intentionally not copied into this repository.
The paper reports variable missingness and heterogeneous analytical methods; pH and some other parameters have substantial missing data.
Median nutrient concentrations are not runtime defaults and must not be interpreted as this project's stream composition or product specification.
